name: Mail Box Management
description: Provides inbox/outbox and mailbox management functionality within Drupal.
project_description:
Mail Box Management Module
 The Mail Box Management module simplifies IMAP email integration for Drupal, enabling seamless inbox management, email fetching, and automation for workflows like support tickets.

 Features 
 The Mail Box Management module connects Drupal to IMAP email accounts, providing advanced email management features:

 
 Securely connect to one IMAP mailbox. 
 Fetch emails, including subject, sender, body, and attachments. 
 Display and organize fetched emails. 
 Process emails with custom workflows for notifications or content. 
 Send mails. 
 Reply to mails. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After installing the Mail Box Management module:

 
 Go to Configuration → Mail Box Management . 
 Enter IMAP server details: hostname, port, SSL/TLS, username, and password. 
 Visit /admin/mailbox-management/configuration to complete the setup.
